notes.title: Farewell from Team 1 & Last Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]This will be our final update for [i]Palette Cleanser[/i]. As of today, we are officially ending development and support for the game. The team is disbanding, and we’re all moving on to new adventures, some of us to other projects, others finishing up our studies, and a few just catching up on sleep.[/p][p]We want to thank every single one of you who played, shared feedback, or simply spent time in our little garden world. This game started as a student project, but your support made it feel like something much more.[/p][p]To wrap things up properly, we’ve released one last patch that fixes a handful of lingering bugs and adds some final polish. You can find the full patch notes below.[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey.
– Team 1 

Patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed delayed music after returning to main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ramp animation and lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with ranged enemies assigned to sprinklers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed airdash spam when jumping on the ramp[/p][/*][*][p]Applied emissive materials to fans[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision on breakable walls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed quitting issue when opening settings from the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where pressing jump after pausing reopened the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed settings menu requiring multiple clicks when accessed from pause[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed credits scene speed[/p][/*][/list][p]New [/p][list][*][p]Sprinkler animations[/p][/*][*][p]More desaturated objects [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[p][b]What’s New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corruption: Now you can clean the corruption off the environment as you slide. [/p][/*][*][p]The garden is bigger: More plants, obstacles, sections and ninja paths![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]The world is even more desaturated to clearly differentiate between the corrupted sections and the cleaned ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera is now easily controllable. [/p][/*][*][p]Various collision issue are now patched[/p][/*][*][p]Placeholder assets have been replaced[/p][/*][*][p]Updated breakable walls[/p][/*][*][p]Big Main menu and Pause menu bugs have been addressed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]We Want Your Feedback[/b][/p][list][*][p]Jump into our Discord Server: [url="https://discord.gg/HKGSBJqN"]https://discord.gg/HKGSBJqN[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Report issues with out build-in tool through the Pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Follow us on Social Media: [url="https://x.com/Pa1etteC1eanser"]https://x.com/Pa1etteC1eanser[/url] & [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@palettecleanser"]Palette Cleanser (@palettecleanser) | TikTok[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank You![/b][/p][p]Big thanks to everyone who’s played so far! Your feedback shapes the game.  [/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p][p]With love, 
Team 1[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Profile Avatars Are Here! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello Little Cleansers!

We're excited to announce that you can now choose from a set of custom avatars for your profile picture! Whether you're feeling heroic, mysterious, or just want to stand out, there's something for everyone.

Head over to your profile settings and pick your favorite avatar today. Let us know which one you like best, or what you'd love to see added in the future!

- Your dear devs!
